title: Where to Buy Silver: Online Dealers, Coin Shops, and Private Sales Compared
description: Premiums range from 2% to 18% over spot depending on where you buy. A practical comparison of online dealers, local coin shops, and private sales so you pay less per ounce.
alt: Where to buy silver comparison showing online dealers at 3-8% premium, coin shops at 8-18%, and private sales at 1-5% over spot
